title: From Pixels to Policy: A Multi-Agent System for Intervention and Geo-Spatial Decision Support
title_zh: 从像素到政策：面向干预与地理空间决策支持的多智能体系统

paragraphs.en: Urban environments are shaped by design choices with long-term implications for health, safety, and quality of life, yet evaluating proposed interventions remains costly, time-consuming, and often impractical. Existing geospatial vision methods largely focus on monitoring urban indicators from aerial and street-view imagery, rather than proposing interventions and estimating their effects on such indicators. Moving beyond recognition, we introduce the problem of discovering interventions that improve target indicators for a given aerial or street-view image. We argue that a black-box indicator model, combined with a generative editing model, can serve as an implicit digital twin for testing intervention hypotheses. We present VIDA-Geo , a multi-agent system that explores this intervention space by coordinating segmentation, diffusion-based inpainting, and indicator scoring models to produce interventions that are both perceptually realistic and aligned with real-world policies. We evaluate our system on 8 indicators across aerial and street-view imagery, measuring changes in factors such as perceived safety and greenery. Our approach outperforms existing baselines in many cases, achieving up to 2 × 2\times higher perceptual quality and policy alignment scores. Finally, our model provides users with multiple candidate interventions, supporting an expert city-planner-in-the-loop workflow. Code is available at https://github.com/HosamGen/VIDA-GEO

paragraphs.en: Visual geospatial data is used in several real-world applications for monitoring and decision-making. Urban planners make use of satellite images to monitor various indicators such as road safety ( Cha et al., 2025 , Elallaf et al., 2026 ) and greenery ( Rahaman et al., 2024 ) . Similarly, climate scientists make use of satellite images to understand pollution ( Guo et al., 2025 , Porcheddu et al., 2025 ) , perceived temperatures ( Ke et al., 2025 , Briegel et al., 2024 ) and thermal exposure ( Zaerpour et al., 2025 , Dousset et al., 2011 ) . Beyond satellite images, experts also make use of other visual information, such as street view imagery or surveillance footage, to monitor perceived safety ( Zhang et al., 2024 , Liu et al., 2023 ) , road-safety ( Yu et al., 2024 , Wei et al., 2025 ) , or walkability ( Berriel et al., 2017 , Nadai et al., 2016 ) .

paragraphs.en: Computer vision research on such visual geospatial data has primarily focused on improving recognition, and consequently, we see highly performing models for many of the aforementioned tasks. However, monitoring via recognition systems is only half of the story. The goal of such planners and scientists is not just to monitor indicators but to intervene when necessary and make changes in accordance with policies. For example, an urban planner might suggest that a particular street is perceived as unsafe due to the presence of scaffolding, and therefore, based on the city’s policy, the scaffolding must be replaced with safer scaffolding. While monitoring is well explored, identifying such recommendations remains underexplored.
paragraphs.zh: 针对此类视觉地理空间数据的计算机视觉研究主要集中于提升识别能力，因此我们在许多上述任务中都能看到性能极高的模型。 然而，通过识别系统进行的监测仅仅是事情的一半。 这类规划者和科学家的目标不仅是监测指标，更在于必要时进行干预，并根据政策做出调整。 例如，城市规划者可能会指出，由于存在脚手架，某条街道被视作不安全；因此，根据城市政策，必须用更安全的脚手架替换原有脚手架。 尽管监测领域已有充分研究，但提出此类建议的识别方法仍属研究不足。

paragraphs.en: Moving beyond visual monitoring, we propose a new framework for visual intervention for decision support . Given an input geospatial image of a region, such as an aerial or street view image, and a black-box indicator prediction model, such as road safety, our framework outputs realistic interventions to the image that improve the indicator score. Our framework could aid policymakers in domains such as urban planning or climate science by providing a diverse set of interventions before implementing interventions in the real world (see fig. 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 除了视觉监测之外，我们还提出了一种用于决策支持的新视觉干预框架。 给定一个区域的地理空间图像输入（例如航空或街景图像）以及一个黑箱指标预测模型（例如道路安全模型），我们的框架会生成对图像的逼真干预措施，从而提升该指标得分。 在真实世界中实施干预之前，我们的框架可以通过提供多样化的干预方案，为城市规划或气候科学等领域的决策者提供支持（见图1）。

sents.zh: 除了视觉监测之外，我们还提出了一种用于决策支持的新视觉干预框架。

sents.en: Given an input geospatial image of a region, such as an aerial or street view image, and a black-box indicator prediction model, such as road safety, our framework outputs realistic interventions to the image that improve the indicator score.
sents.zh: 给定一个区域的地理空间图像输入（例如航空或街景图像）以及一个黑箱指标预测模型（例如道路安全模型），我们的框架会生成对图像的逼真干预措施，从而提升该指标得分。

sents.zh: 在真实世界中实施干预之前，我们的框架可以通过提供多样化的干预方案，为城市规划或气候科学等领域的决策者提供支持（见图1）。

paragraphs.en: The current paradigm for finding interventions in urban planning is to run simulations in digital twins of a city ( Herzog et al., 2025 , Ghaffarian, 2025 ) . However, this has several challenges: 1) they require regular and expensive data collection to maintain the digital twin, 2) the verification of interventions requires expensive and time-consuming simulations, and 3) they could only model specific types of interventions depending on the simulation model.
paragraphs.zh: 当前在城市规划中寻找干预措施的主流方法是在城市的数字孪生体中运行模拟（Herzog 等人，2025；Ghaffarian，2025）。 然而，这种方法存在几个挑战：1）需要定期且昂贵地收集数据来维护数字孪生体；2）验证干预措施需要进行成本高昂且耗时较长的模拟；3）根据所使用的模拟模型，它们只能对特定类型的干预措施进行建模。

paragraphs.en: We instead posit that, rather than creating expensive digital twins, a combination of an indicator monitoring model (recognition) and an image editing model (generative model) can serve as an implicit digital twin (IDT) for creating such interventions. Indicator recognition/monitoring models ( Naik et al., 2014 , Larkin et al., 2021 ) have been shown to be highly accurate. Moreover, as we show in the results (see fig. 8 ), they are also good at handling counterfactuals, which is an important requirement to be treated as a component of an implicit digital twin. However, a prediction model alone cannot serve as an IDT, as it cannot generate interventions. Modern generative models have both realistic generation capabilities and controllable editing ( Rombach et al., 2022 , Wang et al., 2025 ) , including in domains such as satellite imagery ( Cher et al., 2025 , Sastry et al., 2024 ) . Therefore, we use generative editing models to generate realistic interventions.
paragraphs.zh: 我们转而提出，与其创建昂贵的数字孪生体，不如将指标监测模型（识别）与图像编辑模型（生成模型）相结合，从而构成一种隐式数字孪生体（IDT），用于实现此类干预措施。 已有研究表明，指标识别/监测模型（Naik et al., 2014, Larkin et al., 2021）具有极高的准确性。 此外，正如我们在结果部分所示（见图8），这些模型在处理反事实情况方面也表现良好，而这正是其作为隐式数字孪生体组成部分的一项重要要求。 然而，仅凭预测模型本身无法充当IDT，因为它无法生成干预措施。 现代生成模型既具备逼真的生成能力，也支持可控的编辑（Rombach et al., 2022, Wang et al., 2025），甚至适用于卫星图像等领域（Cher et al., 2025, Sastry et al., 2024）。 因此，我们使用生成式编辑模型来生成逼真的干预措施。

paragraphs.en: However, one key question remains: how do we propose realistic interventions that can actually be deployed in the real world, rather than simply optimizing the indicator score? To ensure that interventions are grounded from a policymaker’s perspective, we use large language models (LLMs) for intervention proposals. Specifically, we introduce a multi-agent system with several sub-agents. We start with a high-level planner agent that, given an image, identifies regions of interest (ROIs) that can potentially be intervened upon. The ROIs, along with the image, are passed to a policy sub-agent , which uses real-world knowledge to suggest realistic interventions in the ROIs. These ROIs are also passed to a segmentation agent , which uses several foundation models to find relevant masks for intervention. The generation sub-agent then uses these prompts to generate realistic edits. The edited images are evaluated both for improvement in the black-box indicator score and for whether they remain grounded in the goals of the policy agent . All trials are kept in memory and passed back to the planner agent , which decides the next set of ROIs. Framing this as a multi-agent system allows interventions to be regionally and policy-grounded while remaining modular and understandable to experts. We call this a multi-agent system VIDA-Geo ( V isual I ntervention and D ecision-support A gent for Geo spatial data).
paragraphs.zh: 然而，一个关键问题仍然存在：我们如何提出能够在现实世界中实际部署的干预措施，而不仅仅是优化指标得分？ 为确保干预措施从政策制定者的角度具有现实基础，我们使用大型语言模型（LLM）来提出干预方案。 具体来说，我们引入一个包含多个子智能体的多智能体系统。 我们从高层规划智能体开始，该智能体在给定图像后，会识别出可能需要进行干预的兴趣区域（ROI）。 这些兴趣区域连同图像会被传递给策略子智能体，后者利用现实世界的知识来提出针对这些兴趣区域的可行干预措施。 这些兴趣区域也会被传递给分割智能体，后者使用多个基础模型来寻找与干预相关的面具。 随后，生成子智能体将利用这些提示生成逼真的编辑结果。 编辑后的图像将从两个方面进行评估：一是黑箱指标得分是否有所改善，二是其内容是否仍符合策略智能体的目标。 所有试验结果都会被保留在记忆中，并反馈给规划智能体，由其决定下一组兴趣区域。 将这一过程设计为多智能体系统，使得干预措施既能基于特定区域和政策制定，又能保持模块化且易于专家理解。 我们将其称为多智能体系统 VIDA-Geo（地理空间数据的可视化干预与决策支持智能体）。

sents.en: The generation sub-agent then uses these prompts to generate realistic edits.
sents.zh: 随后，生成子智能体将利用这些提示生成逼真的编辑结果。

sents.en: The edited images are evaluated both for improvement in the black-box indicator score and for whether they remain grounded in the goals of the policy agent .
sents.zh: 编辑后的图像将从两个方面进行评估：一是黑箱指标得分是否有所改善，二是其内容是否仍符合策略智能体的目标。

sents.en: All trials are kept in memory and passed back to the planner agent , which decides the next set of ROIs.
sents.zh: 所有试验结果都会被保留在记忆中，并反馈给规划智能体，由其决定下一组兴趣区域。

sents.en: Framing this as a multi-agent system allows interventions to be regionally and policy-grounded while remaining modular and understandable to experts.
sents.zh: 将这一过程设计为多智能体系统，使得干预措施既能基于特定区域和政策制定，又能保持模块化且易于专家理解。

sents.en: We call this a multi-agent system VIDA-Geo ( V isual I ntervention and D ecision-support A gent for Geo spatial data).
sents.zh: 我们将其称为多智能体系统 VIDA-Geo（地理空间数据的可视化干预与决策支持智能体）。

paragraphs.en: To evaluate our method and future works on this problem, we introduce a new benchmark with evaluation metrics for these 8 tasks. We show that our agentic method can find realistic and grounded interventions by testing it on satellite and street view images across 8 indicator tasks. Our main contributions are as follows.
paragraphs.zh: 为了评估我们在此问题上的方法以及未来的工作，我们引入了一个包含这 8 项任务评估指标的新基准。 通过在 8 个指标任务中测试该方法，我们发现我们的智能体方法能够找到真实且基于实际数据的干预措施。 我们的主要贡献如下。

paragraphs.en: We introduce a new problem setup that moves beyond geospatial monitoring towards intervention for policy-based decision-making.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种新的问题设定，它超越了地理空间监测的范畴，转向了基于政策的决策干预。

paragraphs.en: We provide a new benchmark for evaluating this task, with evaluation metrics that measure the realism of interventions from both image-based and policy-oriented perspectives.
paragraphs.zh: 我们为这项任务提供了一个新的基准，其评估指标从图像和政策两个角度衡量干预措施的真实性。

paragraphs.en: Urban Indicator Estimation Overhead-images have been used for safety and mobility indicators, including crash-risk signals ( Najjar et al., 2017 , He et al., 2021 , Elallaf et al., 2026 ) and pedestrian-network extraction through sidewalks ( Hosseini et al., 2023 , Nadai et al., 2016 ) . Segmentation methods ( Xia et al., 2023 , Demir et al., 2018 ) have also been used to measure vegetation ( Li et al., 2015 , Wolch et al., 2014 ) . Street-view imagery has been widely used to study perceived urban qualities such as safety and liveliness ( Dubey et al., 2016 , Hou et al., 2024 , Naik et al., 2014 ) . Recent work also uses it to model human perceptions ( Danish et al., 2025 , Hamim & Ukkusuri, 2024 ) and for multimodal LLM-based evaluation ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) . While such models are well established, we use them to measure and guide visual interventions that improve an indicator score at a given place.
paragraphs.zh: 城市指标估算中的图像数据已被用于安全与出行指标，包括碰撞风险信号（Najjar 等，2017；He 等，2021；Elallaf 等，2026）以及通过人行道提取行人网络（Hosseini 等，2023；Nadai 等，2016）。 分割方法（Xia 等，2023；Demir 等，2018）也被用于测量植被覆盖情况（Li 等，2015；Wolch 等，2014）。 街景图像已被广泛用于研究城市感知特性，例如安全性与活力感（Dubey 等，2016；Hou 等，2024；Naik 等，2014）。 近期研究还利用其建模人类感知（Danish 等，2025；Hamim & Ukkusuri，2024），并用于基于多模态大语言模型的评价（Zhou 等，2025）。 尽管此类模型已相当成熟，但我们将其用于测量和指导视觉干预，以提升特定地点的指标得分。

paragraphs.en: Intervention and Decision Making Digital twins combine city data and simulations to support evidence-based decision making ( Ghaffarian, 2025 , Cecere et al., 2025 ) . However, such interventions are domain-specific and expensive to simulate. Prior works use counterfactual models to understand the inputs’ effect on the model’s prediction ( Jacob et al., 2022 , Zemni et al., 2023 ) . Others use diffusion models to generate counterfactual explanations for black-box models ( Farid et al., 2023 , Chiquier et al., 2025 , Prabhu et al., 2023 ) . While these works aim to understand model behavior, our goal is instead to use them as real-world actions.
paragraphs.zh: 干预与决策：数字孪生结合城市数据和模拟，以支持基于证据的决策（Ghaffarian, 2025, Cecere et al., 2025）。 然而，此类干预具有领域特异性，且模拟成本高昂。 早期研究使用反事实模型来理解输入对模型预测的影响（Jacob et al., 2022, Zemni et al., 2023）。 其他研究则使用扩散模型为黑箱模型生成反事实解释（Farid et al., 2023, Chiquier et al., 2025, Prabhu et al., 2023）。 尽管这些研究旨在理解模型行为，但我们的目标则是将它们用作现实世界中的行动。

paragraphs.en: Agents for Intervention and Interpretability Remote-sensing VLMs extend instruction-following models to overhead imagery ( Kuckreja et al., 2024 , Zhan et al., 2025 ) , with recent work exploring agentic systems as well ( Xu et al., 2024 , Shabbir et al., 2025 , Kao et al., 2025 ) . Other works show how agents can design experiments to explain model behavior and discover failure modes ( Shaham et al., 2025 , Schwettmann et al., 2023 ) . Related works use generative models to simulate street-view interventions and changes in perceived urban quality ( Hu et al., 2025 , Zhao et al., 2026 ) . Unlike these works, VIDA-Geo formulates urban intervention as a multimodal decision problem. Moreover, the proposed actions are optimized not only for target urban indicators but also for physical realism and policy feasibility.

paragraphs.en: VIDA-Geo is a multi-agent system that takes an image and an improvement goal instruction to produce grounded intervention proposals consisting of a region, an edit, and a textual description . Instead of editing the whole image in one step, it decomposes the problem into specialized agents that reason about where to intervene, what to change, which changes are permissible, and how to generate plausible edits. This creates changes that are localized and atomic and therefore much easier to implement in the real world. The agentic system includes a multi-epoch feedback loop, where summaries of prior epochs inform the subsequent planning and steering away from repeated failure modes.
paragraphs.zh: VIDA-Geo 是一个多智能体系统，它接收一张图像和一个改进目标指令，生成基于实际场景的干预方案，包括一个区域、一项编辑操作以及文本描述。 与一次性编辑整张图像不同，该系统将问题分解为多个专业智能体，分别负责推理干预位置、修改内容、允许的操作类型以及如何生成合理的编辑结果。 这种方式产生的修改具有局部化和原子性，因此在现实世界中更容易实施。 该智能体系统包含一个多轮反馈循环，其中前一轮的总结会指导后续规划，并避免重复出现失败模式。

paragraphs.en: The VIDA-Geo pipeline (see fig. 2 ) consists of four specialized agents followed by a scoring and multi-epoch orchestration. The Planning Agent decides where and what to change; the Policy Agent determines which changes are permissible and which regions are constrained; the Segmentation Agent identifies which pixels correspond to each region of interest; and the Generation Agent creates the visual interventions through prompted inpainting. Candidate interventions are evaluated by the black-box scorer, and the resulting outcomes are used by the Orchestration mechanism to guide later epochs. Each epoch corresponds to one complete planning-to-evaluation cycle. We next present these agents.
paragraphs.zh: VIDA-Geo 流程（见图 2）由四个专用智能体组成，随后是评分和多轮次协调机制。 规划智能体决定在何处以及更改什么；策略智能体确定哪些更改是允许的、哪些区域受到限制；分割智能体识别出哪些像素对应于每个感兴趣区域；生成智能体则通过提示式图像修复创建视觉干预。 候选干预方案由黑箱评分器进行评估，所得结果被协调机制用于指导后续轮次。 每个轮次对应一个完整的规划到评估周期。 接下来我们将介绍这些智能体。

paragraphs.en: Directly editing the entire image is highly unconstrained and may produce unrealistic or infeasible changes. Therefore, the Planning Agent first identifies and ranks multiple ROIs in the image as candidate intervention locations. For each ROI, the planner produces ranked spatial coordinates, bounding boxes, and semantic descriptions or keywords required for the downstream segmentation task in section 3.3 . In later epochs, the planner additionally receives a summary of previous attempts; we describe this feedback mechanism in section 3.5 .
paragraphs.zh: 直接编辑整张图片会缺乏有效约束，可能导致不真实或不可行的修改。 因此，规划智能体首先识别并排序图像中的多个 ROI，将其作为候选干预位置。 对于每个 ROI，规划器会生成排序后的空间坐标、边界框，以及第 3.3 节中下游分割任务所需的语义描述或关键词。 在后续的训练阶段，规划器还会收到先前尝试的摘要；我们将在第 3.5 节中描述这种反馈机制。

paragraphs.en: The Policy Agent then determines the physical and semantic constraints governing each ROI. These constraints fall into three categories: free regions, where any modification is permissible; constrained regions, where edits are allowed but must respect specific rules; and skip regions, which contain critical infrastructure that must remain unaltered. These constraints determine how each ROI may be modified and are also passed to the Generation Agent in section 3.4 . For street-view images, the policy agent also enforces general street-scene plausibility, ensuring that buildings, entrances, and other functional elements remain coherent in any edited output. An example of such policy violations can be seen in fig. 5(a) .
paragraphs.zh: 策略智能体随后确定每个 ROI 所遵循的物理和语义约束。 这些约束分为三类：自由区域（允许任何修改）、受限区域（允许编辑但必须遵守特定规则）以及跳过区域（包含必须保持不变的關鍵基础设施）。 这些约束决定了每个 ROI 的修改方式，并且也会传递给第 3.4 节中的生成智能体。 对于街景图像，策略智能体还会强制执行街道场景的一般合理性要求，确保建筑物、入口和其他功能性元素在任何编辑后的输出中保持一致性。 此类策略违规的示例可见于图 5(a)。

paragraphs.en: Segmentation QC Sub-Agent. Because different segmentation methods can produce inaccurate, overly broad, or fragmented masks, each candidate mask is evaluated by an LLM-based quality-control (QC) step that compares the original image against the binary mask. This evaluation considers three criteria. Coverage checks whether the mask spans the correct target area. Precision estimates how much unrelated regions are excluded. Fragmentation measures how spatially connected the mask is, penalizing, e.g., floating islands.
paragraphs.zh: 分割质量检查子智能体。 由于不同的分割方法可能会生成不准确、范围过宽或碎片化的掩膜，因此每个候选掩膜都会经过一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的质量检查（QC）步骤进行评估，该步骤会将原始图像与二进制掩膜进行比较。 此评估会考虑三个标准。 覆盖性检查掩膜是否覆盖了正确的目标区域。 精确度估计无关区域被排除的程度。 碎片化程度衡量掩膜在空间上的连接性，并对诸如孤立岛等现象进行惩罚。

sents.zh: 分割质量检查子智能体。

paragraphs.en: Feedback loop. Failed masks and their QC descriptions are returned to the Segmentation Agent to adjust the mask selection strategy. The Prompt Suggestion sub-agent revises the segmentation keyword or prompt. This inner closed-loop mechanism improves poor-quality masks before presenting them to downstream intervention stages.

paragraphs.en: The Generation Agent receives the input image and all accepted masks to produce edited images intended to improve the black-box indicator. The images are edited through a mask-and-text-prompted diffusion process, with the Policy Agent ’s constraint annotations injected into the text prompt. These constraints ensure that edits remain consistent with the physical and functional structure of the scene. When mask-based inpainting is not feasible, the agent falls back on mask-free text-guided generation models (see examples in appendix A ).
paragraphs.zh: 生成智能体接收输入图像和所有已接受的掩码，以生成旨在改进黑箱指标的编辑后图像。 这些图像通过基于掩码和文本提示的扩散过程进行编辑，同时会将策略智能体的约束标注注入到文本提示中。 这些约束确保了编辑结果与场景的物理结构和功能结构保持一致。 当基于掩码的图像修复不可行时，该智能体将转而使用无需掩码的文本引导生成模型（参见附录 A 中的示例）。

paragraphs.en: Generation QC Sub-Agent. Because edits may contain unrealistic, inconsistent, or semantically incorrect modifications, the images undergo a QC step that evaluates three properties. Realism checks whether the edited region can plausibly exist in the real world, flagging, e.g., unnatural textures. Coherence verifies that the edit is contextually consistent with the rest of the image. Finally, prompt adherence confirms that the generation agent followed the suggested editing prompt. The complete prompts are present in appendix G .
paragraphs.zh: 生成质量检查子智能体。 由于编辑可能包含不真实、不一致或语义错误的修改，因此图像会经过一个质量检查步骤，以评估三个属性。 真实性检查判断编辑区域是否可能在现实世界中存在，并标记出不自然的纹理等。 一致性验证确保编辑在上下文上与图像的其余部分保持一致。 最后，提示词遵循性确认生成智能体是否遵循了建议的编辑提示词。 完整的提示词见附录 G。

sents.zh: 完整的提示词见附录 G。

paragraphs.en: Policy compliance check. As previously mentioned in section 3.2 , each ROI is associated with policy constraints, verified using the Generation QC to ensure the physical coherence of edits. For example, a residential cluster replacing a retail parking lot is implausible policywise. Violations are fed back to the generation agent so that it can suggest better-aligned prompts. In this work, the regulations come from the LLM’s knowledge; however, a future direction would be to improve policy compliance by incorporating city regulations rulebooks .
paragraphs.zh: 政策合规性检查。 如第 3.2 节中所述，每个 ROI 都与政策约束相关，并通过生成质量检查（Generation QC）进行验证，以确保编辑的物理一致性。 例如，将零售停车场替换为住宅区，从政策角度来看是不合理的。 违规行为会反馈给生成智能体，以便其能够提出更符合要求的提示。 在本研究中，相关法规来自大语言模型（LLM）的知识；然而，未来的一个方向是通过整合城市法规规则手册来进一步提升政策合规性。

paragraphs.en: Feedback loop. Failed outputs, including examples shown in fig. 5(c) , and their corresponding QC feedback are returned to the Generation Agent. The Prompt Suggestion sub-agent then produces a revised editing prompt for the next generation attempt.

paragraphs.en: Finally, for each ROI, multiple edited images may pass quality control. All accepted candidates are scored using the black-box indicator and compared against the original image. Candidates are ranked based on the difference between the two scores (delta score). This process is repeated over multiple cycles, with the results from each cycle passed back to the planning agent. To encourage the agents to identify new regions, produce new masks, and generate alternative edits, all previous candidates and their corresponding delta scores are retained and carried forward to the subsequent cycle.
paragraphs.zh: 最后，对于每个 ROI，可能有多个经过编辑的图像通过质量控制。 所有被接受的候选项都使用黑箱指标进行评分，并与原始图像进行比较。 候选项根据两个分数之间的差异（delta 分数）进行排序。 该过程会重复多个周期，每个周期的结果都会反馈给规划智能体。 为了鼓励智能体识别新区域、生成新掩码并创建替代编辑方案，所有之前的候选项及其对应的 delta 分数都会被保留并带入后续周期。

sents.zh: 最后，对于每个 ROI，可能有多个经过编辑的图像通过质量控制。

paragraphs.en: This accumulated history discourages the system from repeating unsuccessful strategies while encouraging the exploration of diverse editing directions. As a result, this approach yields multiple edited variants from a single input image, each of which adheres to the policy constraints while improving the black-box indicator score.
paragraphs.zh: 这种累积的历史记录会阻止系统重复使用失败的策略，同时鼓励探索多样化的编辑方向。 因此，这种方法能从单张输入图像中生成多个编辑变体，每个变体都遵循策略约束，同时提升了黑箱指标得分。

paragraphs.en: In this section, we discuss the implementation details of our agent, present the benchmark and baselines, and show that our multi-agent system provides realistic and grounded interventions. The implementation details are presented in the appendix ( appendix F ).

paragraphs.en: To perform a comprehensive evaluation with different types of visual geospatial modalities, we sample both aerial images and Street View images. More specifically, we source high-resolution MapBox aerial images and Google Street View images to evaluate interventions.
paragraphs.zh: 为了对不同类型的视觉地理空间模态进行全面评估，我们对航空图像和街景图像进行采样。 更具体地说，我们获取高分辨率的 MapBox 航空图像和 Google 街景图像，以评估干预措施。

sents.en: To perform a comprehensive evaluation with different types of visual geospatial modalities, we sample both aerial images and Street View images.
sents.zh: 为了对不同类型的视觉地理空间模态进行全面评估，我们对航空图像和街景图像进行采样。

sents.en: More specifically, we source high-resolution MapBox aerial images and Google Street View images to evaluate interventions.
sents.zh: 更具体地说，我们获取高分辨率的 MapBox 航空图像和 Google 街景图像，以评估干预措施。

paragraphs.en: For intervention and decision-making, we use black-box indicator prediction models. For aerial images, we select two models: First is BetaRisk model ( Elallaf et al., 2026 ) , trained to predict fatal-crash risk values. The second is OpenEarthMap ( Xia et al., 2023 ) used for greenery prediction. For Street View images, we use the models released with Global Streetscapes ( Hou et al., 2024 ) , which were pretrained on MIT Place Pulse 2.0 ( Dubey et al., 2016 ) , and predict six standard urban perception attributes: safety, lively, beautiful, wealthy, less boring, and less depressing, on a 0–10 scale which we rescale to 0–100.
paragraphs.zh: 在干预和决策方面，我们使用黑箱指标预测模型。 对于航拍图像，我们选择了两个模型：第一个是 BetaRisk 模型（Elallaf 等，2026），用于预测致命性交通事故的风险值。 第二个是 OpenEarthMap（Xia 等，2023），用于预测绿化情况。 对于街景图像，我们使用 Global Streetscapes（Hou 等，2024）中发布的模型，这些模型已在 MIT Place Pulse 2.0（Dubey 等，2016）上预训练，并用于预测六个标准的城市感知属性：安全性、活力、美观度、富裕程度、低无聊度和低抑郁感，评分范围在 0–10 之间，我们将其重新缩放到 0–100。

paragraphs.en: Because the evaluation requires repeated multi-agent and generative model interactions, we prioritize careful assessment over dataset size. For each of the 8 indicators, we score randomly sampled images with the corresponding black-box model and filter out those already scoring above 90 90 . From the remaining pool, a VLM selects 100 images per indicator, ensuring diversity in score, geography, and appearance. See appendix K for benchmark statistics.
paragraphs.zh: 由于评估需要智能体与生成模型之间反复交互，因此我们更重视审慎的评估，而非数据集的大小。 对于 8 个指标中的每一个，我们都用相应的黑箱模型对随机采样的图像进行评分，并筛选出评分已超过 90 分的图像。 从剩余的图像池中，一个视觉语言模型（VLM）为每个指标选择 100 张图像，以确保评分、地理位置和外观的多样性。 基准统计信息请参见附录 K。

paragraphs.en: Evaluating interventions is a challenging problem, as VIDA-Geo and baselines can generate a wide range of possible interventions, and it is not directly observable whether these interventions would be effective in the real world. Therefore, we evaluate such interventions across two complementary axes. First, the perceptual quality of the generated interventions; by determining whether they appear perceptually realistic. Second, the policy alignment ; by determining whether the interventions are realistic and actionable from a policy perspective.
paragraphs.zh: 评估干预措施是一项具有挑战性的问题，因为 VIDA-Geo 和基线模型可以生成各种可能的干预措施，而这些干预措施在现实世界中是否有效却无法直接观察。 因此，我们从两个相互补充的维度来评估此类干预措施。 首先，是所生成干预措施的感知质量；即判断它们在感知上是否逼真。 其次，是政策契合度；即判断这些干预措施从政策角度来看是否现实且可执行。

paragraphs.en: Human Expert Evaluation. We additionally evaluate a subset of our data with seven graduate students and five experts recruited through Prolific ( Prolific, 2026 ) , specializing in urban planning and policy design (see section C.1 ). Evaluators make pairwise comparisons between VIDA-Geo and a selected baseline, providing human validation of perceptual realism and policy compatibility beyond LLM-based evaluation. We also report high agreement between LLM and expert decisions, suggesting that LLM judges can serve as a scalable and reproducible proxy for human judgments (see section C.2 ).

paragraphs.en: Since we propose a new problem of discovering interventions, there are not many relevant strong baselines. The most closely related method is URSimulator ( Hu et al., 2025 ) , which performs perception-guided iterative editing of street-view images with a diffusion model. URSimulator tunes text prompts according to predicted human-perception scores but does not adhere to realism and policy. We additionally adapt methods that generate counterfactuals for interpretability to compare with VIDA-Geo . DIFFusion ( Chiquier et al., 2025 ) interprets differences between 2 classes by using a diffusion model to transform an image’s class. It is a differentiable method that edits via gradient optimization instead of a grounded discrete search like VIDA-Geo . LANCE ( Prabhu et al., 2023 ) utilizes discrete search to find good counterfactuals for a vision classifier. We use it to find edits maximizing indicator scores. We also compare our method against NanoBanana 2.5 in the zero-shot setting (NB2.5 (ZS)), where we directly prompt it to edit an image to improve the black-box score. For fair comparison, all models get the same number of calls to generative models.
paragraphs.zh: 由于我们提出了一个发现干预措施的新问题，因此没有许多相关的强基准方法。 最相关的方法是 URSimulator（Hu et al., 2025），它使用扩散模型对街景图像进行感知引导的迭代编辑。 URSimulator 会根据预测的人类感知分数调整文本提示，但并不遵循真实性和策略约束。 此外，我们还调整了用于生成反事实以增强可解释性的方法，以便与 VIDA-Geo 进行比较。 DIFFusion（Chiquier et al., 2025）通过扩散模型改变图像类别来解释两个类别之间的差异。 这是一种可微分的方法，它通过梯度优化进行编辑，而不是像 VIDA-Geo 那样基于离散的搜索。 LANCE（Prabhu et al., 2023）利用离散搜索为视觉分类器寻找优质的反事实。 我们使用该方法来寻找能够最大化指标分数的编辑。 在零样本设置中，我们还将我们的方法与 NanoBanana 2.5（NB2.5 (ZS)）进行了比较，其中我们直接提示它编辑图像以提高黑盒分数。 为了公平比较，所有模型获得的生成模型调用次数相同。

paragraphs.en: We first test VIDA-Geo quantitatively against the aforementioned baselines. We observe that it achieves the highest overall performance on both performance axes. Additionally, we qualitatively show that VIDA-Geo produces multiple plausible interventions that increase the indicator scores and can be used to provide multiple interventions sequentially.

paragraphs.en: Can VIDA-Geo produce good interventions? We compare VIDA-Geo against other baselines on all 8 tasks in table 1 . paragraphs.en: URSimulator only applies to street view images, where it tends to be more conservative in making edits; moreover, it shows a noticeable gap in policy alignment compared to VIDA-Geo . The zero-shot baseline NB2.5 (ZS) which, unlike VIDA-Geo , is not explicitly designed to search for interventions that satisfy real-world policy constraints. Nevertheless, it achieves a larger task-directed change than VIDA-Geo . For example, Lively and Wealthy scores are improved by 39.1% and 50.8%, respectively, compared to 12.7% and 10.2% for VIDA-Geo . However, these larger changes do not consistently translate into high-quality or realistic interventions. The exception is the Greenery task, where NB2.5 (ZS) performs comparably to VIDA-Geo in perceptual and policy-alignment quality. However, this task is relatively simple, as increasing greenery can often be achieved through simple visual edits such as adding vegetation in empty spaces without requiring complex reasoning.

paragraphs.en: Do VIDA-Geo interventions make sense to experts? We also asked domain experts to pairwise compare the VIDA-Geo against DIFFusion and LANCE for the same inputs. The evaluators were asked, "Which image better reflects the target attribute, which appears more realistic, and which edit would be more feasible in urban planning?". The results reveal a discrepancy between black-box models and human evaluation. Against DIFFusion, experts prefer our agent’s outputs 61.3% of the time on perceptual attribute alignment, compared to only 10% of the black-box models favoring VIDA-Geo . The same trends held against LANCE, where experts preferred VIDA-Geo 86.7% of the time on perceptual attributes and 79.3% of the time on feasibility. Overall, VIDA-Geo achieves the strongest overall human-aligned performance (See appendix C for more results).

paragraphs.en: Can VIDA-Geo do sequential edits? In fig. 4 , we show the results of applying VIDA-Geo sequentially to outputs from a prior run. These sequential edits produce interventions that align with policy and increase the indicator score more than a single edit. For example, in the top row, VIDA-Geo first adds a mural, then expands the buildings, and finally adds texture to the window. The boring score decreases from 53% to 17%, while with single-edit we get the score to 40% at best. This suggests that when urban planners seek larger changes, VIDA-Geo can propose sequential edits that progressively improve the target indicator while largely preserving quality and policy alignment. As shown in fig. 4(b) , goal-aligned scores increase with iterations, while LLM-judges metric decrease slightly, suggesting a reasonable trade-off. Additional sequential analysis can be found in appendix D .

paragraphs.en: We presented a new problem setup moving beyond monitoring towards testing interventions and decision-making. Testing and evaluating successful intervention is a challenge; therefore, we proposed an evaluation benchmark of 8 different tasks across aerial and street view images, consisting of 800 images. We also proposed new metrics to evaluate the quality of such interventions, both perceptually and policywise. To tackle the problem, we introduced VIDA-Geo a multi-agentic method that suggests good grounded interventions. We believe such intervention can be used as decision support to real-life urban planners and policymakers when deciding to change a physical space in the real world.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出了一种新的问题设定，超越了单纯的监测，转向对干预措施和决策的测试。 测试和评估成功的干预措施是一项挑战；因此，我们提出了一个评估基准，包含 800 张航拍和街景图像中的 8 项不同任务。 我们还提出了新的指标，用于从感知和政策两个层面评估此类干预措施的质量。 为了解决这个问题，我们引入了 VIDA-Geo——一种多智能体方法，能够提出合理的落地干预方案。 我们相信，这类干预措施可以用作决策支持工具，帮助现实中的城市规划者和政策制定者在决定改变真实世界的物理空间时做出判断。

paragraphs.en: Limitations and Future Work: Since our work introduces the new problem of visual intervention for geospatial support, we present the first method as a solution. We believe there is substantial room for improvement. For example, in the current system, edits generated by FLUX, especially for aerial images, frequently fail quality checks, leading to over-reliance on NanoBanana. Additionally, replacing closed-source models as agents with open-source counterparts is possible but degrades quality significantly. Furthermore, the current method relies on multiple mask/edit quality checks to ensure good outputs, which could be reduced with better segmentation and editing tools. Finally, this work does not directly encode full zoning law, engineering standards, or construction budgets. However, it is intended as an early-stage decision support for urban planners and policymakers, rather than an implementation system. The generated edits and their indicator scores provide visual proxies that can help experts explore and compare candidate interventions, and we hope that future work will include such constraints to further improve the intervention framework.

paragraphs.en: One concern with sequential editing is the accumulation of artifacts from one iteration to the next, as some acceptable edits may already receive lower LLM-Judge scores after the first iteration and continue to degrade with additional edits. To further analyze this behavior, we iteratively edit 10 inputs per Street View metric and stop when no acceptable edit passes QC or if the edited image reaches the desired goal for the metric (9.0 for increasing metrics and 1.0 for decreasing metrics). We then evaluate the outputs using the LLM-Judge metrics discussed in section 4.2 , and the results can be seen in fig. 7 . This showcases the trade-off between continual editing and the LLM-as-a-Judge scoring. Across tasks, the first iteration produces the largest improvement in the target indicator and generally the highest average LLM-Judge scores, but the following iterations indicate a slight drop in perceptual quality and policy alignment scores. Despite this decline, the average LLM-Judge scores at the final iteration remain above 5.0, suggesting that the resulting edits remain reasonably realistic and policy-aligned.
paragraphs.zh: 顺序编辑的一个担忧是，错误会从一次迭代累积到下一次迭代，因为某些可接受的编辑在第一次迭代后可能已经获得较低的 LLM-Judge 分数，并且随着更多编辑而持续下降。 为了进一步分析这种行为，我们对每个街景指标迭代编辑 10 个输入，并在没有可接受编辑通过质量检查（QC）或编辑后的图像达到该指标的期望目标时停止（对于递增指标为 9.0，对于递减指标为 1.0）。 然后，我们使用第 4.2 节中讨论的 LLM-Judge 指标来评估输出结果，相关结果可见于图 7。 这展示了持续编辑与 LLM 作为评分机制之间的权衡关系。 在各个任务中，第一次迭代对目标指标的改善最大，并且通常获得最高的平均 LLM-Judge 分数，但后续迭代显示出感知质量和策略对齐分数的轻微下降。 尽管存在这种下降，最终迭代的平均 LLM-Judge 分数仍高于 5.0，这表明最终的编辑结果仍然具有合理的真实性和策略一致性。

paragraphs.en: In section 1 , we mention that a model can be considered an Implicit Digital Twin if it has the ability to not only make correct predictions on the in-distribution test data similar to the training data but also on counterfactuals that may be out-of-distribution. Here we present brief qualitative evidence that the black-box models we have chosen perform fairly well on counterfactual edits. Figure 8 , shows changes to the score from these black box model when certain changes are made. While exact score is hard to interpret, the relative increase or decrease is logical.
paragraphs.zh: 在第 1 节中，我们提到，如果一个模型不仅能在与训练数据相似的分布内测试数据上做出正确预测，还能在可能超出分布范围的反事实数据上做出正确预测，那么它就可以被视为一个隐式数字孪生。 在此，我们简要提供定性证据，表明我们所选择的黑箱模型在反事实编辑上的表现相当不错。 图 8 展示了当某些更改发生时，这些黑箱模型的得分变化。 虽然精确的得分难以解读，但相对的增加或减少是合乎逻辑的。

paragraphs.en: The pipeline integrates four models, FLUX-Fill Black Forest Labs (2024) , LISAt Quenum et al. (2025) , SAM Kirillov et al. (2023) , and SAM3 Carion et al. (2026) , which serve as local REST microservices. Region planning and all quality-control agents use GPT-5.1 Singh et al. (2025) . Semantically constrained regions rely on Gemini 2.5 Flash Comanici et al. (2025) , also referred to as NanoBanana 2.5 (NB2.5), which edits via scene-level instruction rather than masked pixel replacement. All the cloud calls to GPT-5.1 and NB2.5 carry no local GPU requirements. The thresholds used in the quality check steps using the LLM judge were 0.7; the number of trials to mask and edit each region is limited to 3 trials per epoch. We set the steps to 30 and guidance to 20 for FLUX.
paragraphs.zh: 该流程集成了四个模型：FLUX-Fill Black Forest Labs (2024)、LISAt Quenum 等 (2025)、SAM Kirillov 等 (2023) 以及 SAM3 Carion 等 (2026)，这些模型均作为本地 REST 微服务运行。区域规划及所有质量控制智能体均使用 GPT-5.1 Singh 等 (2025)。语义约束区域则依赖 Gemini 2.5 Flash Comanici 等 (2025)，该模型亦被称为 NanoBanana 2.5（NB2.5），其编辑方式基于场景级指令，而非通过掩码像素替换。所有对 GPT-5.1 和 NB2.5 的云调用均无需本地 GPU 支持。在使用 LLM 判官进行质量检查的步骤中，所用阈值为 0.7；每个区域在每次迭代中的掩码与编辑尝试次数限制为 3 次。我们将 FLUX 的步骤数设为 30，引导值设为 20。

paragraphs.en: Ablation analysis was completed by disabling some of VIDA-Geo ’s sub-agents, using a subset of 10 images sampled uniformly from each task. The analysis particularly focused on the Policy Restrictions (restrictor) module, the Prompt Suggestion (suggestor) sub-agent, and the Generation QC and Segmentation QC sub-agents. Around 38.3% of the outputs of the models with disabled agents do not produce an image that improves upon the baseline score. Additionally, disabling the QC sub-agents causes a significant drop in scores from 77.7% to 67.1% for the Generation Edit QC and 64.2% for the Segmentation Mask QC in the average LLM-as-a-Judge score, as detailed in table 12 .
paragraphs.zh: 通过禁用 VIDA-Geo 的部分子智能体，并使用每个任务中均匀采样的 10 张图像的子集，完成了消融分析。 该分析特别关注了策略限制（限制器）模块、提示建议（建议器）子智能体，以及生成质量检查和分割质量检查子智能体。 在禁用了部分智能体的模型中，约有 38.3% 的输出未能生成比基线分数更高的图像。 此外，禁用质量检查子智能体会导致分数显著下降：在平均 LLM-as-a-Judge 评分中，生成编辑质量检查的分数从 77.7% 降至 67.1%，分割掩码质量检查的分数则降至 64.2%，具体细节见表 12。

paragraphs.en: VIDA-Geo can support urban planning by making proposed interventions easier to visualize, compare, and prioritize before costly real-world deployment. It is the first of its kind to help in decision making to support engineers and urban planners in planning and modifying regions with multiple indicators in mind. At the same time, the system should not be treated as a replacement for community engagement, expert review, or detailed engineering studies. Because the generated edits and indicator scores depend on pretrained models, they may inherit geographic, socioeconomic, or cultural biases, and visually plausible interventions may still be legally, financially, or physically infeasible. There is also a risk that such tools could be used to optimize for superficial visual improvements rather than deeper structural needs.
